name: Manacles
description: Two iron cuffs on a short chain, with a key.
body:
## What it is

They hold a Small or Medium creature. Slipping them takes a DC 20 Dexterity check and breaking them a DC 20 Strength check; they have 15 hit points. Without the key, picking them takes thieves' tools, proficiency and a DC 15 Dexterity check.
